en: That would be pretty nice.
Kazama-san, Nishiki, Yumi...

Anyone I thought of family has long
since died and left me behind.
Oh... I... I'm sorry...
It's fine. Don't worry about it.

That just means you have to treasure
your family more for my sake, too.

Kiryu-san... That's so deep.
You're a great guy.

I'm nothing special. Sorry to get so preachy.
Wanna get back to drinking?
O-Okay!

You said you were born in Taiwan, right?
What do you think? Is it easy to live in Japan?

Yep. Everyone's so nice, and it's so convenient
here. I love Japanese culture, too.
Japanese culture?

Games, anime, manga...
I love all that stuff!
In fact... I cosplay a lot, too.
Huh. That so?

Kiryu-san, what do you think about that
kind of culture and stuff like cosplay?

It looks so fun.
I'm kinda jealous.

Jealous? I mean, I'm happy,
but that was pretty unexpected.

Yeah. I figured a tough guy like you
would look down on that kind of stuff.

Who am I to judge? Besides, nobody gets to
say one thing is better or worse than the other.

I think it's great to really dive into something.
That said, I can't stand people who half-ass things.

Kiryu-san... You have a wonderful outlook on it.
We should cosplay together sometime. <symbol=note_with_outline>

M-Me...?
Um... Hm. If I'm up to it.

I'm actually a little
interested in it myself...
Whaaat!? You mean that!?

Yeah, people who do it always seem to be having
so much fun. That must mean it's worth the effort.

Kiryu-san, you're so open-minded!
We should cosplay together sometime!

Ahhh, who would you look good as?
Maybe that character... No. <font_kind=yakuza_italic>That</font_kind> character...!

Wait! You'd make a great villain, too! The frog
president with the black mask from that one series!

Wh-What in the world?
Uh, let's start off easy...
To be honest, I don't really get it.

That makes sense. It probably feels like a
totally different world than the one you live in.

But if that world ever gets you down, maybe you
should come chill with us in ours, you know?

Maybe. Sometimes I think
I could use a change of scenery.

If you decide, you just give me a call.
I want to see you cosplay...

You seem pretty accustomed to Japanese life.
Is there anything tough to get used to here?

Hmm... Sometimes the little differences between
Japanese and Taiwanese cultures give me trouble.

Huh, culture differences?
You have an example?

Manners are what really gets me. It's fine to pass
food between chopsticks in Taiwan, but not here.

Also... I can speak the language just fine, but
sometimes I struggle to find the right word.

Especially when it comes to foreign katakana
words. There are so many tough ones, you know?

I get that. Loaner katakana words, huh?
So, would you know this?

Where did that come from, Kiryu-san!? This is
all so sudden... Can you tell I'm blushing?

I guess that was too easy.
Do you know what it means?

Please, of course I know that one! Geez,
you did that on purpose, didn't you? Meanie!
Maybe I did.

Kiryu-san, you can be such a cheeseball.
All the same, I'm happy...

Well, if you're ever stuck on katakana, ask away.
I'll tell you anything, as long as I know it.

Okay. Thanks.
Glad I can rely on you, then.
Soup dumplings...

Of course I know that one! You know,
that's not even written in katakana, you know.
Hrm. Really?

You're a unique one, Kiryu-san. You're this tough
guy, but your hidden inner goofball is so <font_kind=yakuza_italic>moe</font_kind>. <symbol=heart_with_outline>

<font_kind=yakuza_italic>Moeru</font_kind>? Like, you're burning up? Like a fierce
man, a blazing turn of events, or a burning passion?

No no no, not the "burning" kind of <font_kind=yakuza_italic>moe</font_kind>. It's a
slang thing for when your heart is all aflutter.

Oh, well, thank you?
Japanese is rough, huh?

There's that goofball again, Kiryu-san!
I'm going to fall for that <font_kind=yakuza_italic>moe</font_kind> so hard.
Burning <font_kind=yakuza_italic>moe</font_kind>...

Oh! I know that! That's the game console that took
the world by storm, yeah? It's famous in Taiwan, too!

I don't know if it really took the world by storm,
but, I'm surprised you knew about it.

I don't say I'm a gamer for show, Kiryu-san.
Were you a big Dreamcast fan?

No, I've just heard the name before.
I don't know home consoles too well.

Why don't we pick one up and play it at my place?
Nothing beats playing two player games!
Oh, you wouldn't mind having me over?

Ah, you make it sound like I'm seducing you.
I just figured I could trust you, Kiryu-san.

It's not like I go around inviting just anyone
over, y'know? I'm not that kind of woman, okay?

Of course. I can tell you're
on the straight and narrow.

Good. Then, you should definitely come over.
You promise?
Yeah, looking forward to it.

Did you like living in Taiwan, Sora?
Do you ever think about going back?

All the time. When all's said and done,
there's no place like home to me.

But Japan means a lot to me, too. I've met some
great people and made some wonderful memories.

And more than anything else...
there's someone I like here...
Oh? That does make it difficult.

...It just makes me even more
unsure about what I should do.

Is it better to go back,
or live the rest of my life here?
Quite the dilemma...

If he'd come back to Taiwan with me,
I think I'd want to go, but...

If you like him enough to take that big a step,
don't you think you should ask how he feels?

Yeah. You've got to be honest with yourself about
your feelings. You can't keep it all bottled up.

But if I told him I wanted to take him back to
Taiwan, don't you think it'd scare him away?

I don't know. It would depend on the guy.
If you're important to him, he'd probably go.

Then again, if there's something he can't leave
unfinished in Japan, he might choose to stay here.
You're right...

Yep. Either way, I think you're stuck
until you figure out how he feels.

Yeah... Thank you for the pep talk.
It's helping.
Maybe... I should go for an all-out attack.

I admit I'm a little jealous of this guy,
having a girl like you fall for him like this.

He's a <font_kind=yakuza_italic>really</font_kind> good guy. That said,
you're pretty dense, Kiryu-san...
I am?
Yup. But, that's what makes you so moe.
I'm on fire...

Well, you'll find the answer eventually. If fate
leads you back to Taiwan, you'll go back.

But, that said, love takes two. If you wait too
long, you'll only end up full of regret later.
Kiryu-san, has that been your experience?

I've just seen my share... so, if you really
like him, finding out how he feels is worthwhile.
Tai'want to go to Taiwan, too.

K-Kiryu-san...!?
Was that a pun!?

Lame is what it was...
But I really would like to visit Taiwan.

The food is good and I hear they're on good terms
with Japan. I'd like to see it at least once.

Really!? Then let's go sometime!
I'll be your tour guide!
Thanks. I'd need that.

While we're on the subject... How do you feel
about Taiwan, Kiryu-san? Could you live there?

It would depend on the situation. If I had any
unfinished business here, I'd need to stay.

That said, if that wasn't the case, it wouldn't
be so bad to go overseas for a woman I loved.

I see. Good point.
I guess if I don't ask, I'll never know.

Thank you for that!
...I feel like I'm finding my courage now!
Good to hear, and glad I can support you.

Yeah... I have to say, though,
you're pretty dense, Kiryu-san...
Really? I'm trying to be sensitive here...
Oh, are you?

And you're funny, too...
I'll never forget that pun!
I wish you would, actually...

Kiryu-san, umm...
Do you have some time after this?

After this?
I can make the time.

If you're up to it,
would you want to go out together?
Um... I have something I want to tell you...

To tell me? I don't mind going out,
but why can't you say it here?

Well... I'd prefer somewhere with a
little more atmosphere.

Okay. How about we go somewhere
where we can feel the night breeze?
O-Okay! Thank you. <symbol=note_with_outline>
Well, I'll see you later, then!
I'll text you the spot, but...
Can you meet me around Theater Square?
...I can't wait!

My main hobby is cosplay. I mostly dress up
as video game or anime characters.

Wow, cosplay...
Is it fun?

It is! It's especially fun to take video while
dancing around in cosplay and put it up online.

You get to see all the reactions,
and that really makes it.
Let's see... I go to the market a lot.

The market?
Are you looking for good fish?

It's not a fish market! I go to buy loads
of fresh fruit and vegetables.

I haven't been a hostess too long, actually.
I'm still figuring it out.

I'm from Taipei, Taiwan.
My mom's Taiwanese and my dad's half Japanese.

Yep. Tell me, Kiryu-san,
what's your image of Taiwan?

Taiwan, huh?
Let me think...

The first thing that comes to
mind is all the amazing food.
True, it's a great place to eat!

A friend I brought back to Taiwan with me once
loved the dumplings so much, she inhaled 50 of them!

I'd like to go sometime to
get that authentic taste.

You should.
I'll show you all the good restaurants. <symbol=note_with_outline>

I don't know much about it, but it seems
like it's really on the way up?

Oh, "on the way" was a long time ago.
It's already amazing these days.

In fact, Taipei is so prosperous now,
it even rivals Tokyo.

Wow, that's news to me.
I'd like to see for myself someday.

You should.
I'll be your tour guide. <symbol=note_with_outline>
I imagine there's tons of cute girls there.

Aww, is that really your image of it?
Although I guess when I think about it, it's true.

Speaking of cute girls,
you'd count me among them, right? <symbol=note_with_outline>

Really!? That's nice to hear,
even if you are just flattering me... <symbol=heart_with_outline>
Nah, not a chance.

Whaaat? You didn't have to be savage about it...
Kiryu-san, you're mean.

Oh come on, you should say "of course you are"
even if it's a lie... So stubborn, Kiryu-san.

I like noodles.
My favorites are ramen and glass noodles.

I like a man who's really down to earth.
And I love black hair, too.
I'm actually pretty sokubakki.

S-Sokubakki...?
What the heck?
Is that some kind of new cookie?

Not quite! Sokubakki refers to someone who's
controlling. It's from the word <font_kind=yakuza_italic>sokubaku</font_kind>.

I want the person I love to only
have eyes for me, as I would for them.

I could see that.
Well, that's how it works, ideally.

Is that someone who's controlling,
maybe from the word <font_kind=yakuza_italic>sokubaku</font_kind>?

Yes, exactly. The more their love grows,
the more restraints they put on their partner.

On the other hand,
we also tend to enjoy being controlled.
Huh... So it's like consensual restrictions?

I think it's ideal for people who want to
be mutually exclusive to each other.

"Restriction" has kind of a bad connotation,
but if you're both like that, it works out great.

Makes sense.
I can see the logic in it.
I'm more of a kazumakki.

Huh...? Oh...
Uh, sure.

I don't really have a concrete
idea of what I want to do, but...

...I'd like my family back in Taiwan
to be able to see me working hard.

I get that. You just want your family
in Taiwan to be happy, right?

Exactly. They're always so worried about
whether or not I'm getting by okay in Japan.

If I could only show them how hard I'm working
here in Japan, I think they'd be able to relax.
That's a good dream.

I've loved anime and Japanese video
games ever since I was little.

So until about high school,
my dream was to learn magic.

I've long since realized that's
not going to happen, though.

You thought you could learn magic all the way to
high school? You were an awkward kid, huh?
Uh... I won't deny that...
You've unlocked my tragic backstory!

Nothing's impossible.
Never give up on your dreams.

Wh-What's all this all of a sudden, Kiryu-san?
You got really passionate about that...

Ah, maybe you're the type who gets
really fired up after a few drinks?
That's a cute dream.

You think so?
Why, thank you. <symbol=note_with_outline>

Nothing I can show off,
but I am practicing something.
And what's that?

I love horses, so when I'm alone in the bath,
I practice my horse whinny practically every day.

Huh. Horses?
That's cool.
Huh? No, I mean, I still have a long way to go.
Let's hear it then.

I-If you really want me to...
Okay. Here I go.
<font_kind=yakuza_italic>Horse whinnying</font_kind>
